mapper.select: select * from hr_onboarding_import_row where batch_id=#{batchId} order by source_row_number
select * from hr_onboarding_import_row where row_id=#{rowId} for update
mapper.update: update hr_onboarding_import_batch set status='PROCESSING',version=version+1,update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where batch_id=#{batchId} and status='PREVIEWED' and version=#{version} and creator_user_id=#{operatorUserId}
update hr_onboarding_import_batch set update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where batch_id=#{batchId} and status='PROCESSING' and version=#{version}

update hr_onboarding_import_batch set status=#{status},success_rows=#{successRows},failure_rows=#{failureRows}, confirmed_by_user_id=#{operatorUserId},confirmed_by=#{operator},confirmed_time=sysdate(), result_summary=concat('success=',#{successRows},';failure=',#{failureRows}),update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where batch_id=#{batchId} and status='PROCESSING' and version=#{version}

update hr_onboarding_import_row set row_status='SUCCESS',decision=decision,result_onboarding_id=#{onboardingId}, result_code='SUCCESS',result_message='导入成功',processed_by_user_id=#{operatorUserId},processed_by=#{operator}, processed_time=sysdate(),update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where row_id=#{rowId} and batch_id=#{batchId} and row_status='PREVIEWED'

update hr_onboarding_import_row set decision=#{decision},bind_user_id=#{bindUserId},update_by=#{operator}, update_time=sysdate() where row_id=#{rowId} and batch_id=#{batchId} and row_status='PREVIEWED'

update hr_onboarding_import_row set row_status='FAILED',result_code=#{resultCode},result_message=#{resultMessage}, processed_by_user_id=#{operatorUserId},processed_by=#{operator},processed_time=sysdate(),update_by=#{operator}, update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where row_id=#{rowId} and batch_id=#{batchId} and row_status='PREVIEWED'
mapper.delete: delete r from hr_onboarding_import_row r join (select batch_id from hr_onboarding_import_batch where status in #{s} and create_time<#{cutoff} order by batch_id limit #{limit}) expired on expired.batch_id=r.batch_id

delete from hr_onboarding_import_batch where batch_id in (select batch_id from (select batch_id from hr_onboarding_import_batch where status in #{s} and create_time<#{cutoff} order by batch_id limit #{limit}) expired)
